title: Maytronics Dolphin Cycle Completion Gap
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=maytronics:robot
| stats max(_time) as last_cycle by robot
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_cycle)/86400,1)
| where days_since>3
| sort - days_since
description: Uses Maytronics robot telemetry telemetry to monitor time since the pool robot last completed a cycle in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for cleaning gaps before debris and chemistry drift pile up, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Maytronics robot telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Robot table of days since last cycle.
grandmaExplanation: It flags time since the pool robot last completed a cycle so you can spot cleaning gaps before debris and chemistry drift pile up before it becomes annoying.
